title: Geographic Place Catalog Entry
description: One resolver result for a stable place identifier, including lifecycle state. Labels and parent_labels are diagnostic only; value is the authoritative targeting key.

value.description: Stable identifier in the response system and system_version.

subdivision.description: ISO 3166-2 subdivision containing the place when the catalog has a subdivision mapping. Required by resolver semantics when the request constrained subdivision.

label.description: Human-readable display label; never an authoritative targeting key.

canonical_name.description: Required fully qualified display name suitable for distinguishing same-named results.

parent_labels.description: Ordered human-readable parent hierarchy for disambiguation only. Must include at least the containing country.

replaced_by_values.description: Replacement identifiers in the same system and response system_version.

valid_until.description: Known time after which the identifier must no longer be accepted for new targeting.
